headline: Silver Falls 2.8 Percent as Gold and Copper Sell Off
narrative: Silver fell 2.8 percent to 49.3, a liquidation in the precious-metal pipe as money left the metal. Gold fell 1.01 percent to 3,929.4 and copper fell 1.96 percent to 6.42, so the precious-metal and industrial-metal pipes sold off together. Oil rose 0.63 percent to 97.07, the energy pipe taking the bid the metals gave up.
author: jordan
